    Utilization Summary

    Org-wide utilization 86% Oct·proj. close 85.1%·84% Nov·84% Dec·43% Jan (bookings still filling in) Under target 18 Oct · 16 Nov · 17 Dec (forecast)
    Actual Forecast Projected close (hover for the basis) Above target At target Below by ≤20 pts Below by 20–50 pts Below by ≥50 pts

    Why Oct is projected to close lower than today's 85.5%. The Oct figure mixes two things: the weeks already closed count hours actually billed, while the rest of the month still counts scheduled hours. Scheduled hours run high - PTO and sick days are entered after the fact, projects wind down or pause, and late timesheets sit at zero until filed - so the figure drifts as each week closes. This month so far: the closed weeks (of Oct 5 and Oct 12) billed 80% of available hours, while the weeks still ahead (of Oct 19 and Oct 26) are scheduled at 82%; the closed weeks carry 10% of their hours as time off against 5% in the weeks ahead - time off is entered as it is taken, so the scheduled weeks have not absorbed theirs yet. (Project allocations are not the gap: over the last 4 complete weeks the team billed 7,890 of 7,293 allocated hours, +8%, with 19 of 63 employees under their allocation - see Allocation vs Actual.) The projection applies how earlier months moved from day 21 to their close: Aug read 83.0% on day 21 and closed at 82.5% (-0.5 pts); Sep read 89.9% on day 21 and closed at 89.6% (-0.3 pts); the median move is -0.4 pts, so Oct is projected to close near 85.1%. From mid-month the typical move is -1.2 pts. The basis grows every week the refresh runs.
